title: Modern-Trade Deductions and Margin Reconciliation
summary: Reconcile payments from supermarket and large-format chains with your invoices and their GRNs, and check margin, listing, visibility, shortage and damage deductions against agreed terms.

seo.title: Modern-Trade Deductions Reconciliation | VipraTech
seo.description: Reconcile modern-trade payments with invoices and GRNs, and check margin, listing, visibility, shortage and damage deductions against agreed terms.

problem.intro: Supermarket and large-format chains buy on terms negotiated each year: front and back margins, listing and visibility fees, promotion support, payment terms and return rules. They pay against GRNs rather than invoices, and raise debit notes for shortages, damage, price differences and agreed support. Matching those payments and debit notes to what was agreed takes the receivables team days every month.

pain_points.title: Debit notes without context
pain_points.detail: Chains raise debit notes for margin, support and shortages, often with a single line of explanation.

pain_points.title: GRN quantities below invoice
pain_points.detail: Stores and warehouses record lower received quantities, and the short payment follows with no proof.

pain_points.title: Annual terms that no one checks
pain_points.detail: Back margins and fees agreed in the annual terms are deducted at different rates or more than once.

pain_points.title: Old balances that never clear
pain_points.detail: Unexplained differences age for months and are eventually written off.

solution.overview: VipraTech keeps a register of the terms agreed with each chain and reads their payment advice, debit notes and GRN reports. Every payment is tied to the invoices and GRNs it covers, and every debit note is classified and checked against the agreed terms and the receipt evidence. Valid deductions are accepted with their reference; the rest are flagged with the reason, ready for the key account team to raise with the chain.
capabilities: Register of annual terms by chain: margins, fees, support and return rules
Ties every payment to invoices and GRNs
Classifies debit notes and checks them against agreed terms
Flags short receipts, duplicate deductions and rates above terms
Dispute list with evidence for the key account team
Ageing of open differences by chain

workflow.title: Collect
workflow.detail: Payment advice, debit notes, GRN reports and your invoices are gathered for the period.

workflow.title: Tie payments to invoices
workflow.detail: Each payment is matched to the invoices and GRNs it covers.

workflow.title: Classify deductions
workflow.detail: Debit notes and short payments are classified as margin, fee, support, shortage, damage or price difference.

workflow.title: Check against terms
workflow.detail: Each deduction is checked against the chain's agreed terms and the receipt evidence.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: Finance and the key account team review flagged deductions.

workflow.title: Dispute and track
workflow.detail: Disputes are raised with the chain and tracked until recovered or closed.

inputs: Payment advice and remittances from each chain
outputs: Payments tied to invoices and GRNs
Deductions classified and checked against terms
Ageing of open differences by chain
human_in_the_loop: Finance and the key account team decide which deductions to accept or dispute. The system never contacts a chain on its own.
integrations: ERP such as SAP or Tally for invoices and receipts
guardrails: No deduction accepted without matching terms or evidence
Annual terms versioned by chain and year
Every decision keeps its source documents
compliance_notes: Debit notes that change the value of a supply may need matching credit notes for GST; the system keeps the link between debit note, invoice and credit note.

pilot.scope: One chain, using two to three months of payments, debit notes and GRNs, with deductions finance has already reviewed as the benchmark.
deliverables: Terms register for the pilot chain

what_we_measure.how: Share of payments tied to invoices with every deduction explained.
Deductions flagged and confirmed by finance, by count and value.
Time to reconcile a chain's month, compared with today.

faqs.a: Any chain that sends payment advice and debit notes, such as supermarket, hypermarket and department store chains. A pilot starts with the chain where the largest differences sit.

faqs.q: Do you need access to retailer vendor portals?
faqs.a: No. Exports and the remittances you already receive are enough to start.

faqs.q: Can it handle consignment or sale-or-return terms?
faqs.a: Yes, as rules in the terms register, so sales reports and returns are checked against what the chain pays.
Distributor claims settlement is live today. Modern-trade deductions reconciliation is in early access: we are building it with a small number of brands as design partners.
